title: Round467 first-five Max Damage intervention transfer check
status: Configured on the progress-site play page: Round467 PPO + first-five Max Damage action override
summary: With the Round94 selector, paired gains were +7.62 pp [2.73, 12.50] vs Max Damage, +12.30 pp [7.32, 17.29] vs public Counterplay, +8.20 pp [3.42, 12.89] vs PPO Round464, and +8.98 pp [4.00, 13.87] vs PPO Round465. With the website’s Round402 selector, two disjoint 128-cluster seed sets pooled to +13.96 pp [8.89, 19.14] vs Max Damage and +8.01 pp [3.03, 12.99] vs Counterplay.
method: Raw and hybrid arms used fixed teams, previews, repeat indices, and side-swapped games. Paired 95% intervals use 10,000 team-cluster bootstrap resamples. Showdown battle randomness is server-side and not identical between arms. One separate Round402-selector attempt had overlapping generated team-seed ranges and is excluded from all pooled results. All included games completed without action corrections or timeouts; the Round94 Round465 comparison had one incomplete raw case and used 511 matched cases.
intervention: Use legal Max Damage joint actions for battle-decision indices 0 through 4, then return control to the Round467 masked PPO policy.

opponents.source_set: 256 clusters; one raw case incomplete, 511 matched cases

interpretation: The intervention has positive paired evidence across two preview selectors and five tested opponents. It is a promising inference-time candidate, not PPO learning, broad-population robustness, or optimal-play evidence. The win-probability head was not used for action selection. The progress-site play instructions now use Round467 with the first-five override and Round402 selector.
next_step: Audit against a wider policy league and fresh legal responses, then verify a complete websocket match through the local Showdown adapter.
runtime_note: Aggregate evaluation throughput on 8 workers ranged from 3.77 to 9.98 games/s vs heuristic opponents and 3.72 to 7.17 games/s vs PPO policies. This is evaluation throughput, not training rollout throughput; long-game tails create substantial variation.

local_server_match.opponent: poke-env RandomPlayer with a legal generated team
local_server_match.summary: One complete best-of-one match finished on the existing local Showdown server. Round467 PPO + Round402 team selector + first-five legal Max Damage override; match ended after 3 decisions, all handled by the override, with no invalid-action fallbacks. This verifies the main protocol path; forced-switch, disconnect, timeout, and broader action-coverage checks remain open.
